newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Dec 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Dec 30.

text.p: The following is a summary of major South Korean political stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not gaurantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.

- North Korea apologised for submarine infiltration. Apology came from Foreign Ministery spokesman, and was carried by the North's mouthpiece Korean Central News Agency and broadcast by Pyongyang Radio.
- Seoul subway union returned to work on December 29, 11:50 p.m. (1450 GMT)
- Seoul subway union to discontinue strike.
- Pyongyang expected to attend briefing on four-way talks.
